summary: Add free-form alert tagging with persistence, mutation endpoints, tag filtering, and tag data in alert responses.

acceptance_criteria.text: Introduce a new Tag concept with a many-to-many relationship to Alert, including a new join table and migration.
POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags adds one or more tags for an alert, dedupes case-insensitively, enforces a maximum of 10 tags per alert, and enforces a tag length of 1 to 30 characters.
DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} removes a tag assignment and returns 404 when the alert or tag assignment does not exist.
GET /api/alerts supports an optional tag query filter that composes correctly with the existing isActive, severity, created date range, and search filters.

constraints: Maintain the existing layered design: controller -> service -> repository.
Limit each alert to at most 10 tags.
Validate each tag length to 1 through 30 characters after trimming.
Keep GET /api/alerts tag filtering composable with existing filters and paging/sorting behavior.
Return 404 when deleting a tag from a missing alert or when the tag assignment does not exist.
POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags uses a wrapper DTO payload with a tags array.
Persist/display tag casing from the first stored value while deduping and filtering case-insensitively.
coverage_goals: Cover controller status codes and request validation for tag add/remove endpoints.
Cover service orchestration for tag mutation and response mapping including tags.
Cover repository filtering, case-insensitive tag matching, and tag persistence constraints.
